query: update auth.user u set failed_attempt_count = nc.new_count, last_failed_at = $2, locked_until = case when nc.new_count >= $4 then $5 else u.locked_until end from ( select case when last_failed_at is null or last_failed_at < $3 then 1 else failed_attempt_count + 1 end as new_count from auth.user where username = $1 ) nc where u.username = $1
